name: silent-instruments
description: The instrument layer under a verification gate: a measured catalogue of commands that exit 0 having measured nothing — a stale PIPESTATUS, a CI run green because its only job skipped, ancestry after a squash, a truncated API page, a zsh loop that iterates once — plus a PostToolUse advisory that names the cross-check. No linter covers these; ShellCheck catches none of them and refuses zsh outright.
